decisions.rationale: row_count is 10760 and duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, so no exact duplicate rows exist in bronze; dedupe_strategy is none.
runway_id (bronze id) has distinct_count 10760 equal to row_count 10760 and null_count 0, so it alone identifies one row; declared as the sole grain key.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta all carry is_airbyte_metadata true and are capture-tool columns, dropped from silver.

low_end_displaced_threshold_feet has null_rate 0.884201 and high_end_displaced_threshold_feet has null_rate 0.899907, reflecting that most runways have no displaced threshold; both retained nullable rather than dropped.

surface_code has distinct_count 239 and operator context states the surface code set is not fixed (ASP, TURF, CON, GRS, GRE, WATER, UNK and others), so no enumeration is proposed and the column is kept as free text.

operator context states the team spells out abbreviated column names and suffixes measures with their unit, so le_/he_ prefixes become low_end_/high_end_, ident becomes identifier, deg/degt become degrees, and ft becomes feet throughout.

latitude and longitude values carry up to six decimal places (e.g. le_latitude_deg sample -62.187801, he_longitude_deg sample -179.873184), so all four coordinate columns are cast to DECIMAL(9,6) to preserve precision.

purpose: silver_ourairports_runways cleans the bronze OurAirports runways extract into one row per runway, with the low-end and high-end runway details split into clearly named low_end_/high_end_ columns, airport linkage via airport_id and airport_identifier, and surface/boolean flags normalized, feeding downstream runway and airport-capacity analysis.
usage: Join to the airports silver table on airport_identifier (or airport_id) to bring in airport attributes; filter or coalesce the many nullable low_end_/high_end_ measurement columns (latitude, longitude, elevation, heading, displaced threshold) since a large share of runways lack one or both ends' detail, and treat surface_code as free text rather than a fixed enumeration.
limitations: le_/he_ coordinate, elevation, heading, and displaced-threshold columns carry null rates between about 0.22 and 0.90 (e.g. low_end_displaced_threshold_feet 0.884201, high_end_displaced_threshold_feet 0.899907) and are retained nullable rather than imputed; surface_code remains an open, unvalidated set of 239 distinct values with no fixed enumeration available in the source.
